long_biography.plain_text:
John Caudwell entered mobile telephony after a car-dealership payphone bottleneck revealed the value of portable communications. The first order comprised 26 expensive handsets that took months to sell, but the operation grew into the Caudwell Group. Its Singlepoint service business and Phones 4u stores combined distribution, subscriptions and high-street retail at national scale.

After selling Singlepoint and later the wider group, Caudwell redirected capital into property development, aviation and wealth management. His eponymous developer now undertakes luxury residential projects in London and southern France. Philanthropy has become his principal public commitment. He founded charities supporting disabled children and vulnerable young people, and joined the Giving Pledge with a promise to donate most of his wealth.
